source_metadata.title: Comparative efficacy and safety of aspirin, low-molecular-weight heparin, and rivaroxaban for deep venous thrombosis prophylaxis after hip arthroplasty for femoral neck fracture: a single-center randomized controlled trial

source_reconciliation_warnings.message: The narrative reports significant rivaroxaban-versus-aspirin differences in both THA and BHA subgroups and a significant rivaroxaban-versus-LMWH difference in THA, but Table 6 reports only overall three-group subgroup P values and does not provide those pairwise P values. The BHA overall P=0.049 is also above the Bonferroni pairwise threshold of 0.0167 described in Methods. No repair was made.

The sample-size section invokes a 5% noninferiority margin, but the reported primary efficacy analysis is an omnibus chi-square comparison without a reported noninferiority estimate or confidence interval. The extracted atoms preserve the reported analyses without converting nonsignificance into a formal noninferiority result.
The inclusion criterion is printed as “aged ≥ >50 years.” The extraction preserves this source wording rather than silently selecting a corrected threshold.

extraction_limitations: Only the uploaded 10-page article was atomized; the referenced Supplementary material 1 was not provided and was not extracted.
Bibliographic claims in the Introduction and Discussion that summarize prior publications were not atomized as if they were primary results of this trial.
No effect estimates, confidence intervals, NNT/NNH, or formal noninferiority results were calculated beyond values explicitly reported in the source.
